### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **req-1 — Satisfied:** On the RHEL 8.8 system node1, Nginx serves a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6700.
  - **Why:** The target was confirmed as node1 running RHEL 8.8. Nginx was directly observed listening on TCP 6700 and returning HTTP/1.1 200 at the managed-node IP both before and after restart.
